I looked at a screenshot of the whole canvas, and every artboard renders. The 7 discipline slides that I wrote out by hand show up in their usual order (40 Yard Dash through Position Drills), so writing them out changed nothing visible.

- **The headline:** on the FB event cover and its safe-zone check artboard, "STOPKY / NELŽOU" now reads clearly larger. It still sits above the yellow bottom band.
- **Everything else:** the release plan, cover variants B and C, the Instagram posts and stories, the carousel cover and overview, and the A4 card all look as before. They were only on the Stop check's list because they're in the same file. Their code didn't change.

The tool only gives a zoomed-out view of the whole canvas, so I could confirm each artboard renders but not check fine detail. The one thing still worth checking by eye in the studio is whether the bigger headline stays inside the red mobile-crop guides on `fb-event-safe`.
